> Family owned and operated social poker club in Houston Heights. Free lessons for beginners and free dinner daily. Rated 5 from 45 Google reviews.

## About
Lone Star Poker Club is a social poker club in the Houston Heights. We are family owned and operated, and we welcome all veterans.
New to the game? We'll walk you through how to play with free lessons. One reviewer came in on a Wednesday night for their first poker club visit and said the dealers kindly explained the rules of Omaha.
Dinner is on us, membership is free for new members, and private parties are available on request. We're rated 5 from 45 Google reviews.

## Services
- 1/3 NLH
- 1/2/5 PLO
- Free lessons for beginners: We'll show you how to play all of our games.
- Private parties: Host a party or event at the club. One reviewer celebrated a friend's upcoming wedding here, and one group has run a charity poker tournament here.

## FAQ
Q: Is there an age requirement?
A: Yes. Players must be age 21+.

Q: Does membership cost anything?
A: No. All new members receive free membership.

Q: Is there a referral bonus?
A: Yes. Refer a new member and you'll receive a $25 bonus in chips.

Q: How late does the game run?
A: Games can run late, so give us a call before you come by.

## What customers say
- "I recently had the pleasure of attending a private party at Lone Star Poker club to celebrate a friend's upcoming wedding, and I must say, it was an unforgettable experience!

From the moment we walked in, we were welcomed by a warm and friendly staff who made sure we felt right at home. The atmosphere was vibrant yet laid-back, perfect for mingling and having fun with friends. The decor was stylish, creating an inviting setting for both seasoned players and newcomers.

The poker tables were well-maintained, and the staff was always nearby to explain the rules to those who were less familiar with the game.

I highly recommend for anyone looking to host a fun and unique event. I can't wait to go back again for another round!" (leah villarreal, 5/5)
- "Visited on a random Wednesday night for a bit of fun, not knowing what to expect as it was my first ever poker club experience. Incredibly hospitable and cordial dealers and host. I didn't really know the rules of Omaha poker, but they kindly and succinctly explained them to me. The other folks playing seemed to be regulars and were nice too, despite my winning a couple of pots I had no business playing in. Pleasant and good vibes.

Great experience and highly recommended!" (Esam Al-Shareffi, 5/5)
- "We have hosted a charity poker tournament here for a few years running.  Everyone is a consummate professional, accommodating, and fun.  Everyone has a great time for a good cause. Highly recommend." (Cordt Akers, 5/5)

Not the average poker club. Above and beyond awesome." (Mitch M, 5/5)
